description.zh: 为配置好ALB网关路由的应用创建的灰度规则。
description.en: The canary rules for an application that uses an ALB gateway route.

description.zh: 规则描述。不超过64个字符。
description.en: The description of the canary rule. The description can be up to 64 characters long.

description.zh: 为Dubbo应用创建的灰度规则。当您的应用为Dubbo框架时必填，且无需填写**ScRules**参数。
description.en: The canary rules for a Dubbo application. This parameter is required for Dubbo applications and cannot be used with the **ScRules** parameter.

description.zh: 规则名称。支持以小写字母开头，以数字或小写字母结尾，仅可包含小写字母、中文字符、数字及短划线（-）。不超过64个字符。
description.en: The name of the canary rule. The name can be up to 64 characters long and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and Chinese characters. It must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.

description.zh: 为Spring Cloud应用创建的灰度规则。当您的应用为Spring Cloud框架时必填，且无需填写**DubboRules**参数。
description.en: The canary rules for a Spring Cloud application. This parameter is required for Spring Cloud applications and cannot be used with the **DubboRules** parameter.

descriptions.zh: > 目前一个应用只能配置一条灰度规则。
descriptions.en: > You can currently configure only one canary rule per application.
